title: Concept: Yarn lockfile resolves an archive over cleartext
description: yarn.lock declares a lockfile `resolved` URL that uses cleartext http, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The archive crosses the network unencrypted, so it can be replaced before the checksum is computed.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through yarn.lock (npm).
risk: The archive crosses the network unencrypted, so it can be replaced before the checksum is computed.
